map.燃料燃烧放热量（本页代码口径）：Q=质量 m×低位热值 h（h 单位 kJ/kg: Heat released by fuel combustion (as coded on this page): Q = mass m × lower heating value h (h in kJ/kg, Q in kJ); related outputs: megajoules = Q ÷ 1000 (MJ), kilowatt-hours = Q ÷ 3600 (kWh), heat value back-calculation = Q ÷ m (kJ/kg), standard coal equivalent = Q ÷ 29307 (kg at 29307 kJ/kg). Validation: mass and lower heating value must both be > 0, otherwise "Please enter valid parameters" is shown and the calculation stops. Thresholds: no fixed grading; the heat released is linear in both mass and heating value.
